headlines.title: Germany's Merz vows to press on with reforms despite state election losses to far-right AfD
German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
German chancellor Merz vows to stay on despite ‘disaster’ in regional elections
Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
Germany’s Merz stands his ground but for how long?

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The German chancellor Merz called a state election a 'disaster' for his party but vowed to stay on. [2]
Germany's Merz vows to press on with reforms despite state election losses to the far-right AfD. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GERMANY
The state election losses to the far-right AfD suggest a shift in voter support that challenges Merz's reform agenda. [1]

WATCH ITEMS
Merz's commitment to stay on despite the 'disaster' in regional elections may be tested by ongoing political pressure. [3]
